content.text: Updated: Mar. 27, 2026, 2:10 p.m.Published: Mar. 27, 2026, 2:10 p.m.SAN DIEGO, CALIFORNIA - MARCH 18: Jaden Shackelford #5 of the Alabama Crimson Tide drives to the basket against Cormac Ryan #5 of the Notre Dame Fighting Irish during the second half in the first round game of the 2022 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament at Viejas Arena at San Diego State University on March 18, 2022 in San Diego, California.
